global_issues.title: Trump extends tariffs to polysilicon and semiconductor inputs
global_issues.note: Confirmed: Trump signed a Section 232 proclamation (Aug 6) imposing a 15% tariff plus minimum import prices on polysilicon, ingots/wafers, solar cells and modules. However, tariffs take effect Dec 4, 2026, not immediately, and semiconductor chips are only ~2.4% of polysilicon consumption (solar is the primary target) — the briefing's framing of broad 'semiconductor input' cost pressure overstates near-term chip-sector impact. The NVDA offshore-China-access review (Bloomberg, Aug 7) is a separate, real but distinct issue from the polysilicon tariff and is correctly reported as concurrent, not caused by, the tariff action.

missing_major_news.title: Tesla and SpaceX announce $16.8B 'Terafab' semiconductor manufacturing plant in Texas
missing_major_news.impact: TSLA shares gained ~2.8-5.6% this week partly on this news; it is a major AI-chip/semiconductor-manufacturing catalyst directly relevant to the briefing's tariff/semiconductor theme, yet TSLA is only described as 'DOWNTREND'/avoid with no mention of the Terafab announcement or its funding debate (Jefferies cut 2026 EBIT estimate by 37% on cost concerns).

missing_major_news.title: July jobs report miss and hawkish Fed commentary raising September rate-hike risk
missing_major_news.impact: Nonfarm payrolls fell 23,000 (unexpected), and several Fed officials have floated a rate hike (not cut) as soon as September if inflation doesn't ease; September cut odds fell to 44%. This macro backdrop is not reflected anywhere in the briefing's uniformly bullish (green, 94.7) mood score.

grok_report.summary: Core facts (polysilicon tariffs, NVDA export review, and all sampled watchlist stock prices/moves) check out accurately against current sources. The main gaps are omission of the major Tesla/SpaceX Terafab semiconductor investment news (directly on-theme and TSLA-relevant) and no mention of the weak July jobs report / hawkish Fed rate-hike risk, which makes the very high bullish mood score (94.7) somewhat one-sided.
